name: Jovian
description: Gas giants banded in ochre and rust, each with its oval storm, their axes tipped together in slow drifts across the sheet.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { transform: rotate(@rn(-40, 40)deg); :before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 14%; border-radius: 50%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2)); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 14%; border-radius: 50%; background: @p(var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); mask: linear-gradient(transparent 13.5%, #000 14.5% 20.5%, transparent 21.5% 30.5%, #000 31.5% 40.5%, transparent 41.5% 46.5%, #000 47.5% 49.5%, transparent 50.5% 57.5%, #000 58.5% 68.5%, transparent 69.5% 79.5%, #000 80.5% 84.5%, transparent 85.5%), radial-gradient(ellipse 15% 8.5% at 64% 64%, #000 100%, transparent 100%); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box; } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
